ordered_execution_stages: A04_structure_run001: one nonfinancial three-site structural toy and16 unique fixtures, CPU120, zero q10 candidates/target/synthesis
Prospectively freeze the q10 CDF plus exactly the three bond-native candidates and component ledgers
Only if some fixed scalar target has a valid component ledger, prospectively freeze one synthesis registry with the fixed tightest tolerance
target_law: Standard Gaussian masses on1024 uniform-x bins of[-6,6], conditional on that interval; each bin is represented by its midpoint

synthesis_settings.fixed_seed_rule: Seed equals the ordinal of the exact rational angle in the frozen sorted angle registry
synthesis_settings.conditioning: One fixed+1/2 shifted-target call, composed with X, the existing archived certified Rz(1/2) base, X; certify the complete product against the exact native-angle rational
synthesis_settings.identity_rule: An angle may use the empty string only if its independent whole operator matrix certificate is already below the fixed per-rotation allowance

target_and_compression.boundary_method: Use exact symmetry plus the frozen integrated-exp degree256 and Machin240 proof; compute only0 and512 positive boundaries, then reflect
target_and_compression.compression_method: The archived left-to-right truncated SVD, with NumPy1.26.4, one numerical thread, fixed cap2/4/8, and normalization; no extra rank selection
target_and_compression.compression_error: Interval trace distance between the exactly normalized rational-literal rounded target and rational-literal compressed tensor contraction; no sampled fidelity or assumed SVD error guarantee

sequential_emission.canonicalization: Right-to-left QR of the saved compressed cores; retain each binary64 matrix, phase convention, and gauge residual
sequential_emission.unexpected_rank_pattern_action: Preserve the candidate as unsupported; do not adapt ranks or circuits
sequential_emission.output_order: Emit the most-significant Gaussian output bit first, q9 thenq8 throughq0
sequential_emission.active_bond_mapping: Incoming bond basis alpha with a fresh output0 maps by the saved right-canonical core to sum_(s,beta) A(alpha,s,beta)|s,beta>
sequential_emission.unitary_completion: Deterministic lexicographic modified Gram-Schmidt completion of isometry columns, followed by fixed QR with positive diagonal convention; save all defects and charge changes
sequential_emission.contraction_cleanup: When a power-of-two bond shrinks by2, SWAP its highest active bond bit into the next output, then apply the local unitary only on that output and remaining bond wires. The cleared bond wire is never touched again. Literal inverse restores the swaps in reverse order
sequential_emission.native_decomposition: UnitaryGate with input checking enabled; local quantum-Shannon decomposition and two-qubit CX decomposition; transpile once to ry,rz,cx with optimization_level0 and seed_transpiler0
sequential_emission.native_decomposition_operator_certificat: Independently expand every saved local native operation matrix with directed intervals and compare every matrix entry with its saved binary64 local target; Frobenius upper bounds operator error, including complete two-qubit decomposition and recorded global phase
sequential_emission.whole_emission_state_bound: Compose local residual norms with explicit product norm factors for rounded nonunitary core maps; include global tensor normalization and right-canonical gauge residual. No transfer of a single prepared-column error to arbitrary-input operator accuracy
sequential_emission.complete_inverse: Literal reverse chronological emitted Clifford/T/CX/SWAP operations with daggers and tracked global phase; all forward and inverse resources reported separately
sequential_emission.reference_entangled_verification: Independent full local operator certificates plus one fixed dirty entangled13+1-qubit statevector per fixed candidate, with actual native forward and literal-adjoint replay (at most16384 amplitudes, never a dense full global operator). Exact primitive-unitarity/literal-inverse algebra supplies the general inverse identity, while preparation error concerns the declared fresh-zero input

separate_error_ledger.default_four_way_component_reserves: Each term is assigned one quarter of the tightest target; retain actual proved upper bounds and assess their sum at each of the three fixed targets
separate_error_ledger.failed_compression_component_action: Emit at most the already declared native prototype, preserve failed additive-bound rows, and skip expensive synthesis if no fixed target has a valid component ledger; this is a method-bound failure, not an MPS impossibility theorem
separate_error_ledger.missing_certificate_or_censored_synthesi: No claimed certified complete preparation error or full T cost; unknown fields stay null and partial strings stay archived
separate_error_ledger.conditional_product_bound: For fresh disjoint scalar lanes with all complete preparation certificates, joint trace distance<=sum of scalar distances;40 times that bound gives the separately explored preparation dollars
